args.body: If UK-OFFLINE-QA-QUOTE is still open, use director-followup-priority.json if committed, or your own committed shortlist. Prioritize one direct original notice over another feed screen. Even if text matching yields no candidate, use a follow-up slot only if the existing title or lot evidence gives a concrete reason to expect separable offline work. Apply the mission's existing two-source allowance. If the original notice supports a quote, execute the passing and failing controls and leave a private response. Otherwise record the decisive clause or access limit, verify the saved result and close under a valid lease with a lesson. Reuse any completed outcome.
